name: sgs/mega-panel
title: SGS Mega Panel
description: The content container of an SGS mega menu — lives inside a sgs_mega_menu post. Owns ALL variant + colour-scheme styling for its child sgs/mega-group and sgs/mega-aside blocks (parent-paints-child): switching this block's style or colour scheme uniformly reshapes/recolours every group and aside inside it.

background.reason: The megamenu dropdown panel's visibility is toggled by the trigger/JS as a disclosure surface, not by pointer position over the panel shell — once open the pointer is always over some interactive CHILD (a group tile, icon, or link), each with its own hover control. No genuine :hover moment exists on the panel root itself.

sgs._comment_mediaElements: The aside's media is rendered by a CHILD block (sgs/mega-aside, parent-paints-child) — this panel never renders an /

panel.label: Panel
panel._note: The `.sgs-mega-panel` root + its `.sgs-mega-panel__content` row (groupGap is pinned onto this SAME element rather than a separate content element). Block-private (containerMirror:false — this composite uses no SGS_Container_Wrapper grid/section machinery of its own; it hand-rolls its own flex/grid content-row per `style`, mirroring the wrapper's fill/box capability only). variant/style/colourScheme/accent/headings/surfaceBlur/surfaceSaturate/surfaceOpacity are variant-selector + arrangement-mode attrs, not css: property mappings, so they are deliberately absent from attrMap — they select WHICH scoped rule applies. Column COUNT is not a separate attribute — the panel accepts a flexible 1-N sgs/mega-group children (add/remove/reorder), so the number of columns IS the number of groups. group-heading/link/desc/marker are CHILD-OWNED (sgs/heading, sgs/icon-list) and are declared on THOSE blocks' own manifests, not repeated here, even though this panel's CSS paints their colour/shape uniformly. panelBg has no hover pair: the panel is a disclosure surface toggled by the `sgs/nav-bar-menu` mega-item trigger, not an element a visitor points at — there is no genuine `:hover` moment on the ROOT once it is open, only on its children (which have their own hover controls, e.g. the `icon` element below).

aside.label: Aside slot
aside._note: The optional `.sgs-mega-aside` grid column, when a sgs/mega-aside child is present (asideSeparator's border-left divider is a compound value — colour+width+style — so it is documented here rather than mapped to a single css: key). accentBackgroundImageGradient is a gradient sibling for accentBackgroundImage — that base attribute feeds only a COLOUR STOP inside the spotlight glow's radial-gradient (via the derived --sgs-mm-soft-image 10% tint), which a gradient cannot be meaningfully passed through the same way a flat colour can, so when set this BYPASSES that derivation entirely and replaces the WHOLE background-image on the same `[data-spotlight]::before` selector with the raw gradient. Default empty string: the slug+color-mix() behaviour applies when unset.

icon.label: Icon chip
icon._note: CROSS-BLOCK REUSE: the actual rendered selector is `.sgs-icon-list__icon` — a CHILD block's (sgs/icon-list) own BEM class, reused here as markup inside this panel's parent-paints-child model (see the `panel` element's note). This element exists so iconBackground/iconColour (the icon-chip background-color/color painted uniformly across all 3 group styles — columns/cards/minimal) classify to a real owning element. iconColourGradient is the sibling gradient attribute, mapped to the SAME `icon` element, matching `panel`/`group`'s own css:border-color-gradient siblings. iconBackgroundHover/iconBackgroundGradientHover are a hover pair, scoped in render.php/style.css to ONLY the `cards` style's `.sgs-mega-group:hover .sgs-icon-list__icon` — the one style where the icon chip's ancestor has a real hover trigger (the group tile's own lift/shadow hover, see the `group` element note below). Default empty string on both: no colour override at hover until an operator sets one. When set, REPLACES the derived --sgs-mm-soft 10%-tint entirely for the hover state — painted raw, never re-derived through color-mix() (same design choice as accentBackgroundImageGradient on the `aside` element). iconColourHover/iconColourHoverGradient are wired to the SAME `cards`-only ancestor-hover trigger as iconBackgroundHover, for the same reason (columns/minimal have no genuine :hover moment on `.sgs-mega-group`). This element ALSO paints a real background on the SAME selector at BOTH states (the --sgs-mm-soft tint at rest, --sgs-mm-icon-hover-bg on hover) — render.php only swaps the HOVER background onto its own ::after layer when the resolved hover text value is actually a gradient (conditional-swap pattern, as in brand-strip's itemTextColourHover); the flat-colour case (the common one) is byte-identical to the plain iconBackgroundHover rule.

group.label: Group tile
group._note: Targets `.sgs-mega-group` (resting) and `.sgs-mega-group:hover, .sgs-mega-group:focus-within` (hover) — both scoped to the `cards` style's tile only (card hover-lift); `columns`/`minimal` styles render no group-tile border at all. Two attribute pairs share one paired css:border-color + css:border-color-gradient shape in a single attrMap entry: groupBorderColour/groupBorderColourGradient are the RESTING pair (this element's BASE attrMap), default empty string so a fresh instance renders no colour override at rest — the `cards` tile keeps its --sgs-mm-panel-border-derived border (from the `panel` element's shared token) until an operator sets one; groupBorderColourHover/groupBorderColourGradientHover are the HOVER/focus-within pair (base name = resting, base+Hover = hover, as with backgroundColourHover).

iconBackground._note: Feeds the icon-chip `background-color` (via the derived `--sgs-mm-soft` 10% tint) across all 3 group styles. Each painted CSS property has its own control — one colour attribute painting several unrelated CSS properties would block per-property gradient siblings. The generic name follows the codebase convention (attribute name = generic `<element><Property>Colour`, default = bare token slug) and classifies through the `icon` manifest element.

iconBackgroundGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the icon-chip background via background-image, on the SAME `--sgs-mm-soft-gradient` custom property the icon selectors already consume alongside their existing `--sgs-mm-soft` 10%-tint background-color. Non-empty wins over the derived iconBackground tint — the gradient paints at full strength rather than being colour-mixed, since a gradient cannot be meaningfully blended through color-mix().

iconBackgroundHover.description: Hover colour for iconBackground. Scoped to the `cards` style's `.sgs-mega-group:hover .sgs-icon-list__icon` only — the one style where the icon chip's ancestor already has a real hover trigger (the group tile's own lift/shadow hover). Default empty string: no colour override at hover until an operator sets one. When set, REPLACES the derived --sgs-mm-soft 10%-tint entirely for the hover state, painted raw via the --sgs-mm-icon-hover-bg custom property, never re-derived through color-mix().

iconBackgroundGradientHover.description: Gradient sibling for iconBackgroundHover. Non-empty wins over iconBackgroundHover on the SAME hover/focus-within `.sgs-icon-list__icon` state via the --sgs-mm-icon-hover-bg-gradient custom property — same flat/gradient sibling pattern as every other pair in this block.

groupBorderColour._note: Resting-state border-colour control, paired with groupBorderColourHover/groupBorderColourGradientHover (the hover pair; see the `group` manifest element's note). Default empty string: renders NO colour override at rest, so a fresh instance keeps its --sgs-mm-panel-border-derived `cards`-style tile border. Feeds `border-color` on `.sgs-mega-group` (cards style only) via the `--sgs-mm-group-border-resting` custom property, with a `var(..., var(--sgs-mm-panel-border))` fallback chain so an unset value is behaviour-neutral.

groupBorderColourGradient.description: Resting-state gradient override, paired with groupBorderColour above. Non-empty wins over groupBorderColour on the SAME resting `.sgs-mega-group` (cards style) border via a masked ::before ring — independent of the hover pair's own groupBorderColourGradientHover.

groupBorderColourHover._note: Feeds `border-color` on the `cards` style's hover/focus-within state, and is ALSO the default source colour for the aside separator's border-left (asideSeparator.colour still overrides) — that dependency reads the resolved `--sgs-mm-accent-border` custom property. Default 'accent'.

groupBorderColourGradientHover.description: CSS gradient string painting the `cards` style's hover/focus-within border with a masked ::before ring instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over groupBorderColourHover on that hover/focus-within state only.

iconColour._note: Feeds the icon-chip `color` (icon glyph colour) across all 3 group styles. The generic name follows the codebase convention and classifies through the `icon` manifest element.

iconColourGradient._note: Sibling gradient attribute (text-colour/gradient pattern) for `iconColour`. A non-empty valid CSS gradient string wins over the flat `iconColour` on the icon-chip `color`, rendered via `sgs_text_colour_decl()`'s background-clip:text trio + its mandatory `sgs_text_colour_gradient_fallback_rule()` companion. `iconColour` itself is left untouched when this is set, matching every other flat/gradient sibling pair in this block (groupBorderColour/groupBorderColourGradient etc.).

iconColourHover._note: Hover-state sibling of iconColour. Scoped in render.php to ONLY the `cards` style's `.sgs-mega-group:hover .sgs-icon-list__icon` — the same ancestor-hover trigger iconBackgroundHover already uses (columns/minimal have no genuine :hover moment on `.sgs-mega-group`). Default empty string: no override until an operator sets one.

iconColourHoverGradient.description: Hover-state gradient sibling of iconColourHover. Non-empty wins over iconColourHover on the same `cards`-style hover/focus-within state.

accentBackgroundImage._note: Feeds the aside's cursor-spotlight radial-gradient glow (`background`, i.e. a background-image, via the derived `--sgs-mm-soft-image` 10% tint) — only visible when `data-spotlight` is active (view.js). Default 'accent'.

accentBackgroundImageGradient.description: Gradient sibling for accentBackgroundImage. accentBackgroundImage feeds only a COLOUR STOP inside the spotlight glow's radial-gradient via the derived --sgs-mm-soft-image 10% tint — a gradient cannot be meaningfully passed through that same color-mix()-derived stop the way a flat colour can, so when this is set it BYPASSES the derivation entirely and replaces the WHOLE background-image on the `[data-spotlight]::before` selector with the raw gradient, via the --sgs-mm-accent-image-gradient custom property. Default empty string: the existing slug+color-mix() behaviour is completely unchanged when unset.

panelPadding._note: BOX-object shape (top/right/bottom/left per tier) — NOT a scalar. render.php emits this through sgs_emit_responsive_css() with 'box' => true, which reads the four sides; a scalar default such as {desktop:'28px'} would produce NO padding at all, so the panel would render flush to its own border. The declared SHAPE must match what the consumer expects, or the value is silently dropped. Matches sgs/mega-aside's asidePadding shape exactly.

panelBgGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the panel background via background-image (--sgs-mm-panel-bg-gradient custom property). Non-empty wins over panelBg (and the built-in translucent surface default) on the same root selector.

surfaceBlur.description: Backdrop blur: a single CSS length (for example 24px) that blurs whatever sits behind the panel. Empty emits nothing. Emitted through includes/helpers-surface-ground.php.

surfaceSaturate.description: Backdrop saturation as a whole-number percentage (for example 150), paired with surfaceBlur. Unset emits nothing; 0 is a legal value.

surfaceOpacity.description: Fill translucency, 0 to 1, applied to the panel background (panelBg or the built-in surface default). A gradient fill is left as it is. Unset or 1 emits nothing.

shadow.description: Panel shadow: a theme shadow preset slug (whisper, soft, lifted, floating, crisp, long, outline, grounded, glow, pressed, hard) or a raw layer stack composed with shadowColour. Empty means no shadow.

shadowColour.description: Colour for a raw shadow shape in `shadow`; ignored when `shadow` is a theme preset slug.

borderWidth._note: SgsBorderControl attribute. Empty object = unset; render.php falls back to 1px on every side. Base tier only per SgsBorderControl's own contract (per-device border width has no real use case).

borderStyle._note: Paired with borderWidth above. Default 'solid' matches the `border:1px solid` hairline fallback.

brandsEyebrow._note: brands-variant only — a small mono eyebrow label rendered above the logo grid. Deliberately a scalar panel attribute rather than a child block: the brands variant's content (sgs/card-grid + sgs/mega-aside) has no wrapper block available to host a heading ABOVE just the grid (mega-group is locked to heading+icon-list), so the panel renders this text itself, spanning the full content row rather than just the left column.

staggerOnOpen._note: Opt-in staggered-reveal on panel open — maps to the `data-stagger` attribute the shared stagger effect module watches for. Off by default; the disclosure module is what actually toggles the panel open/closed.

viewAllPlacement._note: Where the menu item's own destination link ("View all X") sits INSIDE this panel. That link must exist somewhere reachable — the trigger is a <button>, so without it the item's page is unreachable from the nav and invisible to crawlers — but WHERE it sits is an operator choice, never hard-wired. `auto` = show it only when this panel has no CTA button of its own (so a panel whose aside already links there stays clean); `none` = never; `bottom-left`/`bottom-right` = always, in that corner of the panel's footer row. The enum is declared: block.json default is 'auto', render.php's in_array fallback is ALSO 'auto', and its allow-list is these same four values, so WP's out-of-enum coercion and the PHP fallback produce an identical result for every possible stored value. The declaration is therefore behaviour-neutral, and gives three things: the row classifies via the existing tested TIER 3.5 to role `enum-mode`, WP validates the value, and the client gets a real select control instead of a free-text box. Drift hazard: if render.php's PHP allow-list ever gains a value and this enum is not updated in the same commit, WP will silently coerce the new value to 'auto'.

fxEffect._note: BLOCK-PRIVATE motion-effect selector — NOT the shared fx ToolsPanel roster's `fx` attribute (this block declares `hideExtensions:["fx"]` above and stays off that roster). PHP-validated in render.php against a fixed allow-list of '' | 'cursor-field' | 'particles' | 'grid-dots' | 'wave-gradient', following this block's own existing pattern for `variant`/`style`/`colourScheme` (no JSON enum, because WP coerces an out-of-enum stored value to the default). Deliberately separate from the pre-existing, always-on `.sgs-mega-aside` cursor spotlight (view.js `initSpotlight`) — that effect is scoped to the aside CTA column only and uses its own accentBackgroundImage-derived colour; this attribute governs an ADDITIVE effect scoped to the whole panel root, sharing the render-layer `data-sgs-fx*` contract (`includes/fx-attributes.php` FX_ATTR_MAP) so the same frontend runtime/stylesheets the shared fx roster uses apply here with zero new JS/CSS.

fxFieldType.description: Cursor-field style (FR-38-25) — byte-identical attribute name/type/default to `fx.js`'s own declaration, so the shared `data-sgs-fx-field` render-layer contract and `fx-cursor-field.css` apply unmodified.

fxParticlePreset.description: Particle-trail preset (FR-38-32) — byte-identical shape to `fx.js`'s own declaration.

fxGridDotColour.description: Grid-dot field (FR-38-33) — byte-identical shape to `fx.js`'s own declaration.

fxWaveVariant.description: Flowing-gradient (wave-gradient) style — byte-identical shape to `fx.js`'s own declaration (no default). RESTRICTED to the four CSS-only variants (`pastel`/`horizon`/`ribbon`/`veil`) by `FlowingGradientRowControls.js`'s own `isCssOnlyFlowingGradientVariant()` guard AND, independently, by render.php's own PHP whitelist — `aurora`/`ink` (WebGL-backed) can never reach this block.
